properties.NAME: CRAWFORD (Ark.)
properties.CHANGE: CRAWFORD (Ark.) lost to Choctaw Indian territory in present Oklahoma when the western extent of Arkansas Territory was moved to a line running forty miles west of the southwest corner of Missouri.
properties.CITATION: (U.S. Stat., vol. 4, ch. 155 [1824]/pp. 40-41; Morris, Goins, McReynolds, 21; Van Zandt, 119)
